description.value: The Ocean Marina Hotel is a 42-room, 100% non-smoking property in Port Alberni, BC, located just off Pacific Rim Highway 4 near Clutesi Haven Marina and Sproat Lake Provincial Park. The hotel features onsite dining at Bucksnort's Bar & Grill and Creekers Pub, plus an onsite Creekers Beer & Wine store, making it a self-contained stop after a long day on the road. Free large-vehicle parking and 24/7 coin-operated laundry add practical convenience for touring cyclists passing through the Alberni Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record names this property 'Howard Johnson Hotel' but the discovered website at oceanmarinahotel.ca unambiguously identifies the current operating name as 'Ocean Marina Hotel' — a clear rebrand; per rule 12, the website name is used and the discrepancy flagged. The website content is rich and multi-page, confirming the hotel is open with detailed amenity, dining, accommodations, and contact pages; phone (250) 724-2900 and email info@oceanmarinahotel.ca are listed on the /booknow/ page. No bike-specific amenities (secure storage, tools, wash, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those fields remain null.
concerns: OSM name 'Howard Johnson Hotel' does not match the current operating name 'Ocean Marina Hotel' shown throughout the website — the property has been rebranded. The OSM record should be updated.
Phone number (250) 724-2900 is sourced from the website only; OSM has no phone value, so cross-check confirmation is not possible.
Address 4850 Beaver Creek Road is from OSM only and is not explicitly stated on the website; confirmation is not possible from available evidence.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, currently operating hotel in Port Alberni with an active multi-page website, confirmed phone and email, and detailed amenity listings. No grounds for exclusion.

Laundry.detail: Coin-operated laundry on the 2nd floor, open 24/7

Nearby evening food.detail: Onsite Bucksnort's Bar & Grill and Creekers Pub both offer lunch, dinner, and drinks on the hotel property
